unsupported_features.explanation: Cannot demonstrate effectively in Razor context due to ref struct limitations in method calls and storage. Ref structs have strict constraints that make them impractical for Razor page scenarios.
Requires unsafe code context which is not suitable for Razor pages. Unsafe operations are not practical in web page contexts and would require special compilation flags.
Requires unsafe context and stack allocation which is not practical in Razor page context. Memory management at this level is inappropriate for web applications.
